topic: Nike lost billions in revenue and stock value as shoppers moved to Lululemon, On, Hoka, and New Balance for everyday wear -- a look at what already happened, not a prediction
title: Nike Lost $5 Billion In A Year -- Here's Why
description:
Nike's revenue fell more than $5 billion in a year and its stock lost over 60% of its value since 2021, while Lululemon, On, Hoka, and New Balance picked up the everyday-wear customers Nike used to have by default.

#nike #athleisure #retail #brandstrategy #personalfinance
